issue_context.title: Godot 4.0: Strange Behaivor with Shader Parameter Organization
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 beta 1

### System information

Windows 10, Vulkan, GeForce 1050ti, Intel Core i5 9400f

### Issue description

Shader Material and their parameters are organized strangely depending on the number of parameters you have, with having 32 splits them into 2 seperate tabs, and seems to arbitrarily decide to sort each parameter in each tab by normal alphabetical or reverse alphabetical depending on the number of parameters. 

A Shader Material with 31 or less parameters creates one category called "Shader Parameter"
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29988576/190527800-4fbf4ecd-102a-4353-bb4a-b581be04fb0a.png)

The order in "Shader Parameter" seems to be in reverse alphabetical from top to bottom. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29988576/190528220-03db674c-03a5-4e91-a1c3-a943674722ef.png)

A Shader Material with 32 parameters seems to split the parameters into 2 categories, "Shader Parameter", and "Shader Parameters" (Latter has an "s").
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29988576/190528370-3a864c2a-ff4f-4328-89ea-70c4a1bd2896.png)

"Shader Parameter" Singular seems to sort in reverse alphabetical order,
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29988576/190528480-ee6a32ae-baec-4d91-a9a8-1243ce2fb9ab.png)

While "Shader Parameters" Plural seems to sort in regular alphabetical order.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29988576/190528521-235e36a2-1576-43f6-b6ee-d628047bde49.png)

A Shader Material with 33 Or more parameters makes is similar to one with 32 having both tabs but it makes the "Shader Parameter" tab sort in alphabetical order.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29988576/190528989-a762ad5d-3c52-424a-96be-9fe1cd0e4365.png)



### Steps to reproduce

1. Create 3 shader resources and 3 material resources in the FileSystem Editor.
2. In the shader editor give one shader 31 or less uniforms, give one shader 32, and the last one 33 or more.
3. Attach the Shaders to the materials.
4. Check the materials shader parameters.

### Minimal reproduction project

[Bug4.0.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9579674/Bug4.0.zip)

review_comments: You should remove the UniformPropComparator altogether as it is only used here.
